
```{r setup, include=FALSE}

library(ggplot2)
library(stringr)
library(clusterProfiler)
library(msigdbr)
library(org.Hs.eg.db)        # or org.Mm.eg.db for mouse
library(dplyr)
library(DESeq2)
library(ggrepel)
library(tidyverse)


# --- Set up pathways ---
## Inputs
DESEQ_OBJ_LIST <- here("output/4.downstream_pipelines/de_analysis/data/deseq2_object_list.rds")

## Outputs
OUT_DIR <- here("output/4.downstream_pipelines/de_analysis/data/")
dir.create(OUT_DIR, showWarnings = F, recursive = T)

OUTPUT_HALLMARK <- file.path(OUT_DIR, "HallMark_GSEA.csv")
OUTPUT_GO <- file.path(OUT_DIR, "GO_GSEA.csv")
OUTPUT_REACTOME <- file.path(OUT_DIR, "Reactome_GSEA.csv")
```

# --- Load DESeq2 results---
Those are pairwise comparisons. Each list element has results for all the cell types
We will filter for White Adipocytes

```{r}
# Load
deseq2_list <- readRDS(DESEQ_OBJ_LIST)

#Subset res for White Adipocytes - Neck Comparison
res <- as.data.frame(results(deseq2_list$Threshold_10$`White Adipocytes`, name = "neck_region_Superficial_vs_Deep"))
res <- res %>%
  rownames_to_column("gene")
```

## --- Load the Database for GSEA ---

```{r}
# 1) prerank by “stat” as above:
# Drop any NAs, turn it into a named numeric vector:
#Pull the stat values, which weight the direction and uncertainty
geneList_stat <- res %>%
  filter(!is.na(stat)) %>%
  arrange(desc(stat)) %>%
  { setNames(.$stat, .$gene) }

# 2) grab Reactome from MSigDB (C2 collection, subcollection CP:REACTOME)
reactome_msig <- msigdbr(
  species    = "Homo sapiens",
  collection   = "C2",
  subcollection = "CP:REACTOME"
) %>% select(gs_name, gene_symbol)

gsea_Rctm <- GSEA(
  geneList       = geneList_stat,
  TERM2GENE      = reactome_msig,
   pvalueCutoff   = 0.25,            # looser cutoff
  pAdjustMethod  = "BH",           # still controlling FDR
  minGSSize      = 10,              # include small sets
  maxGSSize      = 300,           # allow big sets
  seed           = 1234,           # reproducible
  verbose        = FALSE
)


# 3) grab GO‐Biological Process (C5 collection, subcollection GO:BP)
go_bp_msig <- msigdbr(
  species    = "Homo sapiens",
  collection   = "C5",
  subcollection= "GO:BP"
) %>% select(gs_name, gene_symbol)

gsea_GO_BP <- GSEA(
  geneList     = geneList_stat,
  TERM2GENE    = go_bp_msig,
   pvalueCutoff   = 0.25,            # looser cutoff
  pAdjustMethod  = "BH",           # still controlling FDR
  minGSSize      = 10,              # include small sets
  maxGSSize      = 300,           # allow big sets
  seed           = 1234,           # reproducible
  verbose        = FALSE
)


# 4) grap Hallmark
m_df <- msigdbr(species = "Homo sapiens", 
                collection = "H")  # “H” = Hallmark
# keep only gene_symbol + gs_name
hallmark <- m_df %>% dplyr::select(gs_name, gene_symbol)

gsea_hallmark <- GSEA(
  geneList       = geneList_stat,
  TERM2GENE      = hallmark,
  pvalueCutoff   = 0.25,            # looser cutoff
  pAdjustMethod  = "BH",           # still controlling FDR
  minGSSize      = 10,              # include small sets
  maxGSSize      = 300,           # allow big sets
  seed           = 1234,           # reproducible
  verbose        = FALSE
)
```
## --- Save Results ---
```{r}
write_csv(as.data.frame(gsea_hallmark), file = OUTPUT_HALLMARK)
write_csv(as.data.frame(gsea_GO_BP), file = OUTPUT_GO)
write_csv(as.data.frame(gsea_Rctm), file = OUTPUT_REACTOME)
```

## --- Session Info ---
```{r}
writeLines(
  capture.output(sessionInfo()),
  file.path(OUT_DIR, "sessionInfo_pseudobulk_GSEA.txt")
)
```
